tasks.q: In the lz4 frame format, which integrity checks can a frame carry, which of them are optional, what does each one cover, and how is each computed? Answer concisely.
tasks.gold: Three checks, all xxHash-32 with seed 0. (1) Header checksum: always present, one byte at the end of the frame descriptor = (xxh32(descriptor) >> 8) & 0xFF, i.e. the second byte of the xxh32 of the full frame descriptor including optional fields. (2) Block checksum: optional (FLG block-checksum flag, bit 4); 4 bytes little-endian after each data block, xxh32 of the raw (compressed/undecoded) block data. (3) Content checksum: optional (FLG content-checksum flag, bit 2); 4 bytes after the EndMark, xxh32 of the whole decompressed content.
rubric: Names xxHash-32 (xxh32) as the checksum function for the checks
Header (descriptor) checksum: always present, one byte, derived from xxh32 of the frame descriptor (second byte / >>8)
Block checksum: optional, per data block, computed over the raw/compressed block data
Content checksum: optional, appended after the end mark, computed over the entire decompressed content
